title: Discernment
definition: Discernment is the ability to distinguish truth from error, wisdom from foolishness, and righteousness from sin according to God's Word.
summary: Believers need discernment because false teaching, temptation, and worldly thinking often appear attractive.
christFocus: Christ guards His people through truth, and His Word trains them to recognize what is faithful.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers need discernment because false teaching, temptation, and worldly thinking often appear attractive.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
